blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With the increasing importance of mobile camera quality in modern smartphones, growing attention has been directed toward computational photography and advanced image signal processing (ISP) algorithms aimed at enhancing various perceptual attributes of captured images. This creates a need for efficient deep learning models for this problem that are not only performant but can also be deployed on constrained mobile hardware. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose the participants to design fast solutions that can reconstruct RGB photos from RAW Bayer camera data while running on popular smartphone GPUs from Qualcomm and Arm. For this, the participants were provided with a large-scale Fujifilm UltraISP dataset consisting of RAW-RGB image pairs captured with the Sony IMX586 Quad Bayer mobile sensor and a professional 102MP medium format FujiFilm GFX100 camera. The runtime of all models was evaluated on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno and Mali GPUs, respectively. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to reconstruct high-quality 5MP RGB image from raw data on both platforms under 100 milliseconds. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.
blocks.zh: 随着移动相机质量在现代智能手机中日益重要,人们越来越关注计算摄影和先进的图像信号处理算法,目的是增强捕获图像的各种感知属性. 这就需要为这一问题建立高效的深层学习模式,这些模式不仅能够发挥作用,而且还可以部署在有限的移动硬件上。 在这项Mobile AI挑战中,我们解决了这个问题,并提议参与者设计快速解决方案,在运行于来自Qualcomm和Arm的流行智能手机GPU的同时,可以重建RAW Bayer相机数据的RGB照片. 为此,向与会者提供了一个大型的Fujifilm UltraISP数据集,其中包括用索尼IMX586Quad Bayer移动传感器捕获的RAW-RGB图像对,以及专业的102MP中型格式的FujiFilm GFX100相机. 所有型号的运行时间在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500芯片上分别与阿德雷诺和马里GPU进行了评价. 在这项挑战中提出的顶级解决方案能够从两个平台的原始数据中重建100毫秒以下的高质量5MP RGB图像. 本文件全面介绍了挑战中开发的模式。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : A sample set of images from the collected dataset. From left to right: the original RAW image visualized with Photoshop’s built-in raw image processing engine, RGB image obtained with MediaTek’s built-in ISP system, and the target Fujifilm photo.

blocks.en: A primary driver of performance improvements in smartphone cameras can be attributed to sophisticated image processing algorithms, including those for noise suppression, accurate color reproduction, and high dynamic range (HDR) imaging. While individual stages of the traditional image signal processing (ISP) pipeline can be replaced by dedicated deep learning models to enhance reconstruction quality, a more comprehensive paradigm involves substituting the entire RAW-to-RGB pipeline with a unified neural network that implicitly learns all intermediate processing steps. Such an approach enables direct utilization of the richer 10–16 bit information contained in the original, unprocessed RAW Bayer data, thereby potentially leading to improved image restoration performance. In [ 54 ] , the authors first introduced this approach by constructing the Zurich RAW-to-RGB dataset comprised of paired RAW and RGB images captured using both a mobile camera sensor and a high-end DSLR camera. This dataset was subsequently used to train a deep neural network for end-to-end image reconstruction. The experimental results demonstrated the strong potential of this method in comparison to the commercial hand-crafted ISP of the Huawei P20 smartphone. Even better results were achieved by the models proposed in the follow-up challenges and papers using the same dataset [ 52 , 15 , 78 , 58 , 46 ] . A further advancement in deep learning–based ISP development was presented in [ 42 , 29 ] , where the authors introduced a more advanced Fujifilm UltraISP dataset for the considered task along with mobile-efficient CNN architectures capable of processing high-resolution images directly on smartphones. In this competition, we use the same dataset and propose the participants to design even more efficient learned ISP models that can run on recent smartphone GPUs.
blocks.zh: 智能手机相机性能改进的主要驱动力可以归因于精密的图像处理算法,包括用于噪声抑制,准确的色彩复制,以及高动态范围(HDR)成像的算法. 虽然传统图像信号处理(ISP)管道的个别阶段可以被专用的深层学习模型所取代,以提高重建质量,但更为全面的范式是用一个统一的神经网络取代整个RAW到RGB管道,暗含学习所有中间处理步骤. 这种办法能够直接利用原始的、未经处理的RAW Bayer数据所载的较丰富的10至16位信息,从而有可能改进图像恢复性能。 在[54]中,作者首先通过构建苏黎世RAW-to-RGB数据集引入了这种方法,该数据集由使用移动相机传感器和高端DSLR相机捕获的对称RAW和RGB图像组成. 这个数据集后来被用于训练一个深神经网络,用于端到端的图像重建. 实验结果表明,与华威P20智能手机的商业手动ISP相比,这种方法具有强大的潜力. 利用同一数据集在后续挑战和文件中提议的模型取得了更好的成果[52、15、78、58、46]。 [42、29] 作者在深层学习-基于ISP的开发方面进一步取得进展,为深层学习任务推出了一个更先进的Fujifilm UltraISP数据集,以及能够直接在智能手机上处理高分辨率图像的移动高效CNN架构。 在这场比赛中,我们使用相同的数据集,并提议参与者设计更高效的能运行在最近智能手机GPU上的学会的ISP模型.

blocks.en: Designing deep learning models that run efficiently on mobile devices — especially across different AI accelerators like NPUs — is a complex challenge. It demands careful analysis of hardware constraints such as limited operator support, restricted memory capacity and bandwidth, reduced accuracy for quantized models and specific driver behavior of NPUs. Even when certain layers or operations are technically supported, they may be executed inefficiently due to constraints related to NPU hardware architecture or its driver implementation, and thus create performance bottlenecks during inference. A striking example here would be the Google Tensor NPU present in all recent Google Pixel smartphones that, despite having quite high theoretical peak performance, is unable to efficiently accelerate the vast majority of even simplistic CNN-based models [ 39 ] . As a result, achieving low latency and energy efficiency often requires partial or complete redesigns of model architectures. For a more detailed discussion of these challenges and the performance of modern mobile AI accelerators we refer to [ 47 , 44 ] . Overall, all these limitations require various adaptations of the standard deep learning models for their efficient deployment on mobile NPUs, including conventional optimizations like 16-bit / 8-bit [ 12 , 57 , 56 , 93 , 67 , 73 , 8 , 77 , 79 , 68 ] and low-bit [ 10 , 83 , 5 , 55 , 70 , 97 , 6 , 60 , 16 , 7 , 65 ] quantization, network pruning and compression [ 12 , 66 , 69 , 74 , 59 , 20 , 96 , 89 , 61 , 85 ] , NPU-specific adaptations, platform-aware neural architecture search [ 21 , 80 , 87 , 84 , 72 , 14 , 95 , 88 , 13 , 94 ] , etc .
blocks.zh: 设计在移动设备上高效运行的深层学习模型——特别是跨不同AI加速器如NPU——是一个复杂的挑战. 它要求对硬件限制进行仔细分析,如操作员支持有限,内存容量和带宽有限,量化模型的精度降低以及NPU的特定驱动行为. 即使某些层或操作得到了技术支持,但由于与NPU硬件架构或其驱动程序执行相关的限制,它们也可能被低效地执行,从而在推论过程中产生性能瓶颈. 例如Google Tensor NPU在最近所有Google Pixel智能手机中, 尽管理论上的峰值性能相当高, 因此,实现低延迟和能效往往需要对示范建筑进行部分或全面的重新设计。 关于这些挑战和现代移动AI加速器的性能的详细讨论,我们提到[47,44]. 总体而言,所有这些限制都需要对标准深层学习模式进行各种调整,才能有效部署在移动式NPU上,包括16位/8位等常规优化[12,57,56,93,67,73,8,77,79,68]和低位[10,83,5,55,70,97,6,60,16,7,65] 量化,网络穿插和压缩[12,66,69,74,59,20,96,89,61,85],NPU特有的改造,平台神经架构搜索[21,80,87,84,5,55,70,97,6,60,16,7,65] 等.

blocks.en: In this Mobile AI Challenge, the participants were proposed to develop efficient deep learning models that can reconstruct 5MP RGB image from RAW Bayer data while running on smartphone GPUs. For this, the participating teams were provided with the Fujifilm UltraISP dataset [ 42 ] consisting of thousands paired photos captured with a normal mobile camera sensor and a professional 102MP medium-format FujiFilm GFX100 camera. The runtime of the models was evaluated on mobile GPUs present in the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and the Dimensity 9500 chipsets. Each submission was evaluated based on both image fidelity and runtime efficiency, thus balancing reconstruction quality with model efficiency. All solutions developed during this challenge are fully compatible with the LiteRT [ 75 ] (former TensorFlow Lite) framework, enabling deployment on a variety of Linux and Android-based IoT platforms, smartphones, and edge devices.
blocks.zh: 在本次移动AI挑战中,参与者被提议开发高效的深层学习模型,可以在智能手机GPU上运行的同时从RAW Bayer数据中重建5MP RGB图像. 为此,向参与小组提供了Fujifilm UltraISP数据集[42],其中包括数千张配对照片,并附有普通移动相机传感器和一台专业的102MP中型FujiFilm GFX100相机。 这些模型的运行时间在Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500芯片中的移动GPU上得到了评价. 每次提交都根据图像真实性和运行时间效率进行评价,从而平衡了重建质量与模式效率。 在这项挑战期间开发的所有解决方案都与LiteRT [75] (原TensorFlow Lite)框架完全兼容,使得能够在各种Linux和基于Android的IoT平台,智能手机,和边缘设备上部署.

blocks.en: This challenge addresses the above issues. Real training data, tools, and runtime evaluation options provided to the challenge participants are described in the next sections.
blocks.zh: 这一挑战涉及上述问题。 下几节介绍为挑战参与者提供的实际培训数据、工具和运行时间评价选项。

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集

blocks.en:
In this challenge, we use the Fujifilm UltraISP dataset [ 42 , 29 ] collected using the Fujifilm GFX100 medium format 102 MP camera capturing the target high-quality images, and a popular Sony IMX586 Quad Bayer mobile camera sensor that can be found in tens of mid-range and high-end mobile devices released during the past years. The Sony sensor was mounted on the MediaTek Dimensity 820 development board, and was capturing both raw and processed (by its built-in ISP system) 12MP images. The Dimensity board was rigidly attached to the Fujifilm camera, and they were shooting photos synchronously to ensure that the image content is identical. The dataset contains over 6 thousand daytime image pairs captured at a wide variety of places with different illumination and weather conditions. An example set of full-resolution photos from the Fujifilm UltraISP dataset is shown in Fig. 1 .
As the collected RAW-RGB image pairs were not perfectly aligned, they were initially matched using the state-of-the-art deep learning based dense matching algorithm [ 82 ] to extract 256 × \times 256 pixel patches from the original photos. It should be mentioned that all alignment operations were performed on Fujifilm RGB images only, therefore RAW photos from the Sony sensor remained unmodified, exhibiting the same values as read from the sensor.
blocks.zh:
在这项挑战中,我们使用Fujifilm UltraISP数据集[42,29]收集,使用Fujifilm GFX100中型格式102MP相机捕获目标高质量图像,以及流行的Sony IMX586 Quad Bayer移动相机传感器,在过去几年中发布的数十个中程和高端移动设备中可以找到. 索尼传感器安装在MediaTek Dimensity 820开发板上,并正在捕捉原始和处理(通过其内置的ISP系统)12MP图像. Dimensity板被僵硬地附着在藤叶电影的相机上,他们同步拍摄照片以确保图像内容一致. 数据集包含在多种不同地点捕捉到的六千多对白天图像配对,具有不同的照明和天气条件. Fujifilm UltraISP数据集的一套全分辨率照片实例见图1。
由于所收集的RAW-RGB图像对称不完全对齐,最初使用最先进的基于深层学习的密集匹配算法[82]进行配对,从原始照片中提取256×\times 256像素补丁. 值得一提的是,所有对齐操作都只在Fujifilm RGB图像上进行,因此索尼传感器的RAW照片仍未修改,显示的数值与从传感器读取的相同.

blocks.en: 2.2 Local Runtime Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.2 当地运行时间评价

blocks.en: When developing AI solutions for mobile devices, it is vital to be able to test the designed models and debug all emerging issues locally on available devices. For this, the participants were provided with the AI Benchmark application [ 44 , 47 ] that allows to load any custom TensorFlow Lite model and run it on any Android device with all supported acceleration options. This tool contains the latest versions of the Qualcomm QNN, MediaTek Neuron, Hexagon NN, TFLite GPU, Android NNAPI, Samsung ENN, Amlogic AML and Arm NN delegates, therefore supporting all current mobile platforms and providing the users with the ability to execute neural networks on smartphone NPUs, APUs, DSPs, GPUs and CPUs.
blocks.zh: 在为移动设备开发AI解决方案时,必须能够测试所设计的模型,并在可用设备上调试所有在当地出现的问题. 为此,向参与者提供了AI基准应用程序[44,47],该应用程序允许加载任何自定义的TensorFlow Lite模型,并在任何Android设备上运行,并带有所有支持的加速选项. 该工具包含Qualcomm QNN,MediaTek Neuron,六角NN,TFLite GPU,Android NNAPI,三星ENN,Amlogic AML和Arm NN代表的最新版本,因此支持所有当前的移动平台,并为用户提供在智能手机NPU,APU,DSP,GPU和CPU上执行神经网络的能力.

blocks.en: 2.3 Runtime Evaluation on the Target Platform
blocks.zh: 2.3 目标平台运行时间评价

blocks.en: In this challenge, we use two flagship mobile SoCs as our target evaluation platforms: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno 840 and Arm Mali G1-Ultra MC12 GPUs, respectively, that can be found in numerous flagship smartphones. The models were parsed and accelerated using the TFLite GPU delegate [ 63 ] that demonstrated the best runtime results on both platforms. NPU runtimes provided for reference were obtained by running the models with the Qualcomm QNN and MediaTek Neuron TFLite delegates on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and the Dimensity 9500 SoCs. All final solutions were tested using the aforementioned AI Benchmark application.
blocks.zh: 在这一挑战中,我们使用两个旗舰移动SoC作为我们的目标评价平台: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和MediaTek Dimensity 9500芯片,分别配有Adreno 840和Arm Mali G1-Ultra MC12 GPU,这可以在众多旗舰智能手机中找到. 这些模型使用TFLite GPU代表[63]进行了解析和加速,该代表展示了两个平台的最佳运行时间结果。 与Qualcomm QNN和MediaTek Neuron TFLite的代表一起运行了Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和Dimensity 9500 SoCs的模型,从而获得了提供参考的NPU运行时间. 所有最终解决方案都使用上述AI基准应用程序进行了测试。

blocks.en: 2.4 Challenge Phases
blocks.zh: 2.4 挑战阶段

blocks.en: The challenge consisted of the following phases:
blocks.zh: 挑战包括以下几个阶段:

blocks.en: I. Development: the participants get access to the data and AI Benchmark app, and are able to train the models and evaluate their runtime locally; II. Validation: the participants can upload their models to the remote server to check the fidelity scores on the validation dataset, and to compare their results on the validation leaderboard; III. Testing: the participants submit their final results, codes, TensorFlow Lite models, and factsheets.
blocks.zh: 我从你那得到的 I. 开发:参与者可以获得数据和AI基准应用程序,能够在当地培训模型并评估其运行时间; 验证:参与者可以将其模型上传到远程服务器,以检查验证数据集上的忠诚度分数,并在验证领导板上比较其结果; III. 测试:参与者提交最终结果,代码,TensorFlow Lite模型,以及事实表.

blocks.en: Development: the participants get access to the data and AI Benchmark app, and are able to train the models and evaluate their runtime locally;
blocks.zh: 开发:参与者可获得数据和AI基准应用程序,能够培训模型并在当地评估运行时间;

blocks.en: Validation: the participants can upload their models to the remote server to check the fidelity scores on the validation dataset, and to compare their results on the validation leaderboard;
blocks.zh: 验证:参与者可以将其模型上传到远程服务器,以检查验证数据集上的忠诚分数,并在验证领导板上比较其结果;

blocks.en: Testing: the participants submit their final results, codes, TensorFlow Lite models, and factsheets.
blocks.zh: 测试:参与者提交最终结果,代码,TensorFlow Lite模型,以及事实表.

blocks.en: 2.5 Scoring System
blocks.zh: 2.5 分红系统

blocks.en: All solutions were evaluated using the following metrics:
blocks.zh: 所有解决方案均采用下列衡量标准进行评估:

blocks.en: • Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) measuring fidelity score, • Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) as proxy for perceptual score, • Mean Opinion Score (MOS) obtained from a user study and used to evaluate the perceived aesthetic quality of the reconstructed RGB image, • The runtime on the target Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 GPU.
blocks.zh: · 峰信号对噪比(PSNR)测量忠诚度分数, · 结构相似性指数度量(SSIM)作为知觉分数的代名词, · 由用户研究获得并用来评价被重建的RGB图像的感知美学质量的平均值, 目标Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5和 Dimensity 9500 GPU的运行时间。

blocks.en: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) measuring fidelity score,
blocks.zh: 峰值信号对噪音比(PSNR)测量忠诚度分数,

blocks.en: Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) as proxy for perceptual score,
blocks.zh: 结构相似性指数度量(SSIM)作为知觉分数的代名词,

blocks.en: Mean Opinion Score (MOS) obtained from a user study and used to evaluate the perceived aesthetic quality of the reconstructed RGB image,
blocks.zh: 从一项用户研究中获得的Mean Opture Score(MOS),用于评价重建的RGB图像的感知美学质量,

blocks.en: The runtime on the target Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 GPU.
blocks.zh: 目标Snapdragon 8精英Gen 5和Dimensity 9500GPU的运行时间.

blocks.en: The score of each final submission was evaluated based on the next formula ( C C is a constant normalization factor):
blocks.zh: 根据下一个公式评价了每份最后划界案的得分(CC是一个常态化系数):

blocks.en: Final Score = 2 2 ⋅ (PSNR + MOS) C ⋅ runtime , \text{Final Score}\,=\,\frac{2^{2\cdot\text{(PSNR + MOS)}}}{C\cdot\text{runtime}},

During the final challenge phase, the participants did not have access to the test dataset. Instead, they had to submit their final TensorFlow Lite models that were subsequently used by the challenge organizers to check both the runtime and the fidelity results of each submission under identical conditions. This approach solved all the issues related to model overfitting, reproducibility of the results, and consistency of the obtained runtime / accuracy values.
blocks.zh: 在最后的挑战阶段,参与者无法使用测试数据集。 相反,他们必须提交最后的TensorFlow Lite模型,这些模型后来被挑战组织者用来检查每次提交在相同条件下的运行时间和忠诚度结果。 这种方法解决了与模型过度调整、结果的可复制性以及所获得运行时间/准确值的一致性有关的所有问题。

blocks.en: 3 Challenge Results
blocks.zh: 3 挑战结果

blocks.en: In this challenge, 6 teams entered the final phase and submitted their results, TFLite models, codes, executables and factsheets. Table 1 summarizes the final challenge results for both tracks and report PSNR, SSIM and runtime numbers for the valid solutions on the final test dataset and on the target evaluation platform. The proposed methods are described in section 4 , and the team members and affiliations are listed in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 在这个挑战中,6支队伍进入了最后阶段,并提交了结果,TFLite模型,代码,可执行文件以及概况介绍. 表1汇总了在最后测试数据集和目标评价平台上有效解决方案的轨道和报告PSNR、SSIM和运行时间数字的最后挑战结果。 第4节介绍了拟议方法,附录A列出了小组成员和隶属关系。

blocks.en: 3.1 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 3.1 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Figure 3 : LKSNet architecture proposed by team MiAlgo
blocks.zh: 图3:米阿尔戈团队提出的LKSNet架构

blocks.en: All submitted solutions demonstrated a very high efficiency: the majority of models are able to process one 5MP (1920 × \times 2560 px) image under 0.5 seconds on both target GPUs. This shows great progress in both model design as well as in mobile AI acceleration hardware that is currently able to provide decent speed-up for many common network architectures. Team MiAlgo is the challenge winner: the solution proposed by this team was able to demonstrate over 60 and 22 FPS when running on the Adreno and Arm GPUs, respectively. This highlights that the considered model can be potentially applied even for FullHD RAW video processing while achieving a frame rate of over 30 FPS on current mid-range and high-end smartphone SoCs. It should be mentioned that this model is additionally compatible with NPUs from both Qualcomm and MediaTek, yielding an additional 2 × \times runtime speed-up in the latter case. Very similar numerical and visual results were demonstrated by team AVC2 , which solution was slightly slower on both platforms. The best perceptual quality was achieved with solution developed by team UAIC_ISP . Despite using a relatively large model, its runtime was still not exceeding one second on the considered mobile GPUs, making it possible to use this solution for practical applications.
blocks.zh: 所有提交的解决方案都表现出非常高的效率:大多数模型都能够在两个目标GPU的0.5秒内处理1个5MP(1920×\times 2560px)图像. 这表明在模型设计和移动AI加速硬件方面都取得了巨大进展,这些硬件目前能够为许多共同的网络架构提供体面的加速. Team MiAlgo是挑战的获胜者:这支队伍提出的解决方案在分别运行于阿德雷诺和Arm GPU时,能够展示超过60和22 FPS. 这凸显出,被考虑的模型甚至有可能适用于FullHD RAW视频处理,同时在目前中程和高端智能手机SoCs上实现超过30 FPS的帧率. 需要提及的是,这种模型与Qualcomm和MediaTek的NPU都额外兼容,在后一种情况下会产生额外的2×\时间的运行时间加速. 团队AVC2展示了非常相似的数值和视觉结果,这两个平台的解决方案稍慢. 通过团队UAIC_ISP开发的解决方案,实现了最佳的认知质量. 尽管采用了相对较大的模型,但其运行时间在被认为的移动GPU上仍然不超过一秒,使得将这种解决方案用于实际应用成为可能.

blocks.en: A notable progress that should be highlighted is the ease of model conversion to the target TFLite format. Table 1 shows that the majority of solutions in this challenge were developed using the PyTorch ML framework. Due to the recently presented litert-torch plugin 4 4 4 https://github.com/google-ai-edge/litert-torch developed by the LiteRT team, one can now directly convert the majority of PyTorch models to the TFLite format without the need for TensorFlow / Keras model re-implementation or use of ONNX as an intermediary format. This significantly simplifies the development process of mobile-friendly deep learning architectures for the majority of researchers using PyTorch as their main framework for AI model development and training.
blocks.zh: 应当强调的一个显著进展是模式转换为目标TFLite格式的便利。 表1显示,这一挑战中的大多数解决办法是使用PyTorch ML框架制定的。 由于最近推出的Litert-torch插件 4 4 4 https://github.com/google-ai-edge/litert-torch 由LitERT团队开发,现在人们可以直接将大多数PyTorch模型转换为TFLite格式,而不需要TensorFlow / Keras模型重新实施或使用ONNX作为中间格式. 这大大简化了大多数以PyTorch为主要框架的研究人员的移动友好型深层学习架构的开发过程,用于AI模型开发和培训.

blocks.en: 4 Challenge Methods
blocks.zh: 4 挑战方法

blocks.en: This section describes solutions submitted by top teams participating in the final stage of the MAI 2026 Learned ISP challenge.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍参加MAI 2026学习ISP挑战最后阶段的顶级团队提交的解决方案.

blocks.en: 4.1 MiAlgo
blocks.zh: 4.1 米阿尔戈

blocks.en: Team MiAlgo based its solution on the SYENet [ 19 ] architecture. The proposed LKSNet (Large Kernel Skip Net) model (Fig. 3 ) starts with 3 × \times 3 convolution used to preprocess raw input data. Then, 7 × \times 7 depthwise convolution and 3 × \times 3 convolution extract features separately and multiply them together. After adding learnable bias and applying channel attention, the features are upsampled by 2 × \times and multiplied with skip-connected 3 × \times 3 convolution features. Finally, the RGB output is obtained after adjustment through 3 × \times 3 convolution.
blocks.zh: Team MiAlgo将其解决方案基于SYENet[19]架构. 拟议的LKSNet(Large Kernel Skip Net)模型(图3)开始于3×\time 3 convolution,用于预处理原始输入数据. 然后, 7 × 时 7 深 时 3 × 时 3 时 3 时 3 时 分别 抽取 特征 并 乘以 。 在增加了可学习的偏差并应用频道关注度后,这些功能被2××\time所放大,并乘以跳动连接的3××\time3的演化功能. 最后,RGB输出通过3×\time 3的演化在调整后获得.

blocks.en: In addition to the SYENet loss function, MSE losses are computed separately for low-frequency and high-frequency image information through FFT-based filtering. The authors also incorporated color loss [ 25 ] , LPIPS, SSIM, and cosine similarity losses to better preserve perceptual quality, structural consistency, and feature similarity in the reconstructed images. The entire training split of the dataset was utilized for tuning model parameters with a batch size of 32 and a learning rate of 1e–3.
blocks.zh: 除了SYENet损失功能外,MSE损失是通过基于FFT的过滤法对低频和高频图像信息分别计算的. 作者还纳入了彩色损失[25],LPIPS,SSIM,以及余弦相似性损失,以更好地保存知觉质量,结构一致性,并在重建的图像中突出相似性. 数据集的整个培训分工用于调整模型参数,批量规模为32个,学习率为1e-3。

blocks.en: 4.2 AVC2
blocks.zh: 4.2 反车辆地雷2

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Network architecture proposed by team AVC2
blocks.zh: 图4:AVC2小组提出的网络架构

blocks.en:
Team AVC2 introduced a simplified version of MobileIE [ 91 ] , a lightweight image signal processing network designed for mobile deployment that balances performance and efficiency using reparameterization, as illustrated in Figure 4 .
The architecture first employs an MBRConv 3 × 3 3\times 3 layer followed by a Tanh activation for initial feature extraction.
Subsequently, the feature maps are fed into two parallel branches.
Each branch consists of an MBRConv 3 × 3 3\times 3 layer with a residual connection.
The outputs of the two branches are fused via element-wise multiplication.
After these blocks, a simplified version of the Hierarchical Dual-Path Attention (HDPA) module is employed to refine features.
Upsampling is achieved through a Pixel Shuffle layer, followed by a final MBRConv 3 × 3 3\times 3 layer generating the output image.
A key aspect is the MBRConv block, which utilizes multiple parallel convolutional branches with batch normalization during training; these blocks are reparameterized into standard single convolutional layers for efficient inference.
blocks.zh:
Team AVC2引入了简化版MobileIE[91],一个为移动部署设计的轻量级图像信号处理网络,通过重新参数化平衡性能和效率,如图4所示.
该架构首先使用MBRConv 3×3 3\times 3层,之后是Tanh激活,用于初始特性提取.
随后,地物图被输入两个平行分支.
每个分支由一个MBRConv 3×3 3\times 3层组成,并有剩余连接.
两个分支的输出通过元素相乘而成。
在这些块之后,使用一个简化版的等级双帕注意(HDPA)模块来完善特征.
Upsampling是通过像素洗涤层实现的,之后是最后的MBRConv 3×3 3\times 3层生成输出图像.
一个关键方面是MBRConv区块,该区块利用多个平行的分流分支,在训练期间进行批量正常化;这些区块被重新调整成标准的单一分流层,以便有效推论.

blocks.en:
The network was trained using the L 1 L_{1} loss function, favored for promoting sharper image reconstruction [ 4 , 90 , 92 ] .
The Adam optimizer was utilized with a cosine annealing learning rate schedule.
The schedule started with an initial learning rate of 1e–3, preceded by a 10-epoch warm-up phase at a fixed rate of 1e–6.
The learning rate was subsequently reset every 50 epochs before decaying. The model was trained for a total of 5000 epochs with a batch size of 32.
The training employed 24000 aligned raw-sRGB image pairs, partitioned into 22000 for training and 2000 for testing.
blocks.zh:
使用L1 LQQX1}损失函数对网络进行培训,
亚当优化器被使用 与余弦反射学习率表。
计划以1e-3的初始学习率开始,然后是10世纪的热身阶段,固定速度为1e-6。
学习率随后在衰败前每50个纪元重设一次. 该型号共培训了5000个世纪,批量规模为32.
培训采用了24 000对对齐的原始SRGB图像对,分为2 000对用于培训,2000对用于测试。

blocks.en: 4.3 UAIC_ISP
blocks.zh: 4.3 国际空间信息学联合会(UAIC_ISP)

blocks.en: Team UAIC_ISP proposed an improved version of its solutions from the previous learned ISP challenge [ 38 ] . The authors made changes to both the architecture and the training method, which resulted in a PSNR score on the validation data that was improved by more than 0.6 dB.
blocks.zh: Team UAIC_ISP从之前学到的ISP挑战中提出了改进版的解决方案[38]. 作者们对架构和培训方法都做了修改,结果在验证数据上得出了PSNR的分数,改进了0.6 dB以上.

blocks.en: The proposed architecture is a modified version of RMFA-Net [ 64 ] , in particular the version designed for smartphone inference (Fig. 5 ). The signal passes through a black level correction module, an input module, two refinement blocks, and one output module. In the first module, the input has its black levels corrected by subtracting learnable per-channel black level offsets, then scaled by learnable per-channel multipliers, and clamped to the valid range [0,1]. In the input module, the input is processed through two 3 × \times 3 convolutional layers to extract features and then passed through a Tanh activation to map the output to the range (-1, 1). Each block addresses feature representation by incorporating a dedicated texture module, a tone mapping module, and both channel and spatial attention mechanisms. In the texture module, the input is processed through two parallel branches — a 1 × \times 1 convolution for high-frequency details and a 3 × \times 3 convolution for low-frequency patterns, then their outputs are concatenated. The tone mapping module processes the input through hierarchical downsampling and upsampling to estimate global illumination features, which are subtracted from the input to produce reflectance according to the Retinex theory [ 62 ] . The channel attention module uses global average pooling and 1 × \times 1 convolutions to compute channel-wise weights, enhancing important features via sigmoid scaling, while the spatial attention module applies average pooling across channels followed by a 7 × \times 7 convolution to generate spatial attention maps that refine feature locations. In the last module, the input is upsampled using pixel shuffle, then refined with a final convolution, and mapped to the [0,1] range with a Sigmoid activation.
blocks.zh: 拟议架构是RMFA-Net[64]的修改版,尤其是为智能手机推论设计的版本(图5). 信号通过一个黑色关卡校正模块,一个输入模块,两个完善块,和一个输出模块. 在第一个模块中,输入通过减去每个通道的可学习性黑色水平偏移来修正其黑色水平,然后通过每个通道的可学习性乘数来缩放,并夹住有效范围[0]. 在输入模块中,输入通过两个 3×\time 3 折叠层进行处理,以提取特性,然后通过Tanh激活来将输出映射到范围(-1, 1). 每个区块都包含一个专用的纹理模块,一个音调映射模块,以及信道和空间注意机制,从而解决了代表性问题。 在纹理模块中,输入通过两个平行分支进行处理——高频细节的1×\times 1转式和低频模式的3×\times 3转式,然后它们的输出被调和. 声调映射模块通过分级下采样和上采样处理输入,以估计全球照明特征,这些特征从输入中扣除,以按照Retinex理论产生反射[62]. 频道注意力模块使用全局平均集合和1×时 1 的编组来计算频道偏重,通过sigmoid缩放增强重要功能,而空间注意力模块则应用跨频道平均集合,然后是7×时 7 的编组来生成空间注意力地图,完善特征位置. 在最后一个模块中,输入被使用像素洗涤来进行检测,然后用最后的演化来精炼,用Sigmoid激活来映射到[0,1]范围.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Deep learning architecture proposed by team UAIC_ISP
blocks.zh: 图5:UAIC_ISP团队提出的深层学习架构

blocks.en: The model was trained in four stages with adversarial losses from [ 3 ] . In the first stage, it was trained for 10 5 10^{5} steps using the Adam optimizer with a fixed learning rate of 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 5\cdot 10^{-4} and a batch size of 16. Both discriminators had a fixed learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and were trained with Adam at a frequency of 1:10 relative to the neural ISP. The losses and weighting system were the same as in [ 3 ] . The training was then continued for 10 5 10^{5} more steps. At this time, the color loss was changed so that instead of minimizing the pixel differences in blurred versions, the Mean Squared Error (MSE) was directly applied. This MSE loss component was weighted 10 times more than any other and the batch size was reduced to 8, while all other details remained the same as in the first stage. During the third stage, the only difference was that the learning rate was decreased from 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 5\cdot 10^{-4} to 10 − 5 10^{-5} by a linear scheduler in the first 10 5 10^{5} steps. In the last stage, the model was trained for 2 ⋅ 10 5 2\cdot 10^{5} steps, while the content, total variation loss, and DISTS [ 17 ] loss were removed, meaning that the only losses used were MSE, LPIPS+ [ 11 ] and the adversarial texture losses that rely on the LPIPS+ features. The authors additionally used the manually filtered selection of the dataset, where 17.6% of the training dataset was removed.
blocks.zh: 该型号经过四个阶段的训练,从[3]受到对抗性损失. 在第一阶段,它接受了10 5 10^{5 } 步骤的训练,使用 Adam 优化器,固定学习率为 5⋅ 10− 4 5\cdot 10^{4 }, 批量大小为 16. 两名歧视者的固定学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5 5 ,与Adam一起接受了与神经ISP相对的频率为1:10的训练. 损失和加权制度与[3]相同。 然后继续培训10 5 10^{5] 更多步骤。 此时,颜色损失被改变,以便不把模糊版本的像素差异最小化,而是直接应用Mean Squared Error(MSE). 这一MSE损失部分的加权比任何其他部分多10倍,批量规模减少到8个,所有其他细节与第一阶段相同。 在第三阶段,唯一的区别是,在前10 5 10 10 10 5 5 5 5 5 5 5) 步骤中,通过线性排程器将学习率从 5 10 - 4 5 5 5 5 5 5 减到 10 - 5 在最后一个阶段,该型号接受了2⋅ 10 5 2\cdot 10^{5}步骤的训练,而内容,总变异损失,和DISTS[17]损失被移除,这意味着所使用的唯一损失是MSE,LPIPS+[11]和依赖于LPIPS+特性的对抗纹理损失. 作者还额外使用了人工过滤的数据集选择,其中17.6%的培训数据集被移除.

blocks.en: 4.4 NAF
blocks.zh: 4.4 国家森林基金

blocks.en: Figure 6 : NAF-Enhanced Smallnet model (top) and the NAFBlock architecture (bottom) proposed by team NAF
blocks.zh: 图6:NAF-增强的Smallnet模型(顶部)和NAFBlock架构(底部) 团队NAF提出的NAF

blocks.en:
Team NAF proposed an architecture illustrated in Fig. 6 . The model starts with a 4-channel input, first generating basic RGB features through three convolutional layers, dimensional transformation, and color correction (gamma correction and s-curve mapping). Subsequently, it expands the 3-channel RGB features to 32 channels via an upsampling convolution, enhances these features using a NAFBlock (that includes depthwise convolution , SimpleGate , SCA attention , and FFN structure ), reduces the dimensionality back to 3 channels, and combines the result with the original basic RGB features through a residual connection. Finally, it outputs an RGB image within the [0,1] range. The main novelty of the proposed model lies in the integration of a NAFBlock to enhance feature representation while preserving the integrity of the original features and improving fine details.
The model was trained with a combination of the structural similarity loss and the mean absolute error (MAE) loss, balancing pixel-level error minimization and preservation of image structural consistency: ℒ ( y true , y pred ) = 0.15 ⋅ 1 N ∑ i = 1 N ( 1 − SSIM ( y true , i , y pred , i ) ) + \displaystyle\mathcal{L}(y_{\text{true}},y_{\text{pred}})=0.15\cdot\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\left(1-\text{SSIM}(y_{\text{true},i},y_{\text{pred},i})\right)+ + 1 N ∑ i = 1 N | y true , i − y pred , i | \displaystyle+\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\left|y_{\text{true},i}-y_{\text{pred},i}\right|
blocks.zh:
国家农联小组提出了图6所示的结构。 模型开始采用4通道输入,首先通过3个演化层生成基本的RGB特征,维变,以及颜色校正(伽玛校正和S曲线映射). 随后,它将3通道的RGB特性通过一个上采样的演化扩展至32个信道,使用一个NAFBlock(包括深智演化,SimpleGate,SCA注意,和FFN结构)增强这些特性,将维度降低回3个信道,并通过一个剩余连接将结果与原始的基本RGB特性结合. 最后,它输出[0]范围内的RGB图像. 拟议模型的主要新颖之处在于整合了NAFBlock,以加强特征代表,同时保持原始特征的完整性并改进精细细节.

blocks.en: 4.5 MFI
blocks.zh: 4.5 小额供资机构

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Multi-level feature interaction model presented by team MFI
blocks.zh: 图7:小额供资机构小组提出的多层次特征互动模式

blocks.en:
Team MFI proposed a multi-level feature interaction (MFI) module which architecture is illustrated in Figure 7 . The input of MFI is a 4 channel raw image, which is first processed by a 1 × \times 1 convolution layer. Then, MFI splits into two branches for further processing. In the main branch, the feature map is processed by the PixelShuffle layer, yielding the upsampled feature map I u I_{u} . Then the feature map I u I_{u} is processed by several 3 × \times 3 convolution layers. Inspired by SENet [ 22 ] , the authors introduced a channel attention module to enhance the feature representation ability of the model and output the first feature map.
In the secondary branch, features are processed sequentially by a 3 × \times 3 convolution layer, a PixelShuffle layer, and a 3 × \times 3 convolution layer to obtain the second feature map.
blocks.zh:
MFI小组提出了一个多层次特征互动模块,其架构如图7所示。 MFI的输入是一个4通道的原始图像,它首先由1×\time 1的演化层处理. 之后,小额供资机构分成两个分支进行进一步处理。 在主分支中,特征图由PixelShuffle层处理,生成了被检测的特征图I u I_{u}. 然后功能图 I u I_{u} 由数个 3 ×\time 3 演化层处理. 在SENet[22]的启发下,作者引入了一个频道关注模块,以提高模型的特征表达能力,并输出第一个特征映射.
在二级分支中,特征通过一个3×x\time 3的演化层,一个像素Shuffle层,和一个3×xx 3的演化层相继处理,以获得第二个特征图.

blocks.en: The main branch uses only a 1 × \times 1convolution layer before the PixelShuffle layer, which can reduce the computational cost of the model and maximally preserve the high-frequency spatial information from the original image, while the secondary branch focuses on the low-frequency information of the image. Then, the two branches interact with each other by element-wise multiplication, which can further enhance the nonlinear processing capability of the model. The fused features are further multiplied element-wise with another feature map derived from I u I_{u} after a 1 × \times 1 convolution layer and Sigmoid activation function, which aims to enhance the retention of high-frequency spatial information. Finally, the resulted feature map is added to I u I_{u} and processed by several 3 × \times 3 convolution layers to obtain the final RGB image.
blocks.zh: 主分支在PixelShuffle层之前仅使用1×\time1的演化层,可以降低模型的计算成本,并最大限度地从原始图像中保存高频空间信息,而副分支则注重图像的低频信息. 然后,两个分支通过元素偏移乘法互相相互作用,这可以进一步提高模型的非线性处理能力. 引信的特性在元素上进一步乘以另一个从I u I_{u}中衍生出来的特性图,在1××\time 1 演化层和Sigmoid激活功能之后,该功能的目的是加强高频空间信息的保存. 最后,结果的特征映射被添加到I u I_{u}中,并由数个3×\time 3的演化层处理,以获得最终的RGB图像.

blocks.en: The model was trained with the L 1 L_{1} loss function and the Adam optimizer. The initial learning rate was set to 1e–4 and decayed by a factor of 0.9 every 10 epochs. The model was trained for 400 epochs with a batch size of 4.
blocks.zh: 该模型接受了L1 LQQ1}损失函数和亚当优化器的训练. 初始学习率定为1e-4,衰减系数为每10个世纪0.9。 该型号为400个纪元,批量规模为4.
